Press Escape for the lesson menu.
Press N to go to the next step.
Press Shift and key G for a course of gates in this scene. A new course replaces the old one.
Press B to go back one step.
Press Z to hear the task of this step again, with its sounds.
Press key Shift and key K when the game stops for a new sound you know already.
Press X to leave the lesson for the main menu. The lesson is saved.
